title: fix(console): skip link as the shell's first Tab stop; record dialogs open on their first field (objectui#13130)
body:
Fixes #13130

Clause-②: no

Two keyboard defects from the console walkthrough (Showcase → Contacts). The shell had no skip link, so a list's New was about the 60th Tab stop. The record Create/Edit dialog opened with focus on Close instead of the first field.

## What changed

**Skip link** (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `ConsoleLayout`). A "Skip to content" link is rendered first in the console shell, before `AppShell`, so it is the first Tab stop in an ordinary session. It stays out of sight until focused (`sr-only focus:not-sr-only`, pinned top-left while focused). Activating it calls `preventDefault()` and focuses the route slot: the `console-route` div that holds the page, which now carries `id="console-main-content"` and `tabIndex={-1}`. No hash is written into the URL (objectui AGENTS §5 #8). Its text is `console.skipToContent`, in all ten packs.

**Dialog initial focus** (`@object-ui/plugin-form`: `ModalForm` plus the new module `initialFieldFocus.ts`). Both of `ModalForm`'s dialog arms (the flat form and the master-detail `subforms` form) now pass `onOpenAutoFocus` and `onCloseAutoFocus` to `MobileDialogContent`. On open, if the first editable field is already drawn, it gets focus. If not, the dialog element itself (Radix's `tabIndex={-1}` container, named by its title) takes focus, and a `MutationObserver` watches the body. When the first editable field lands, focus moves to it, but only while focus is still on the dialog element; a control the user reached in the meantime keeps focus. "Editable field" means the first enabled, non-read-only control inside a `[data-field]` row, the same selector the form renderer's `revealField` already uses. Inactive tab panels are skipped.

## Measured mechanism: assumption 2 does not hold

- **Assumption 1 holds.** No skip link exists: a grep for `skip to`, `skip-link`, `skipTo…` across `packages/app-shell`, `packages/layout` and `apps/console` at `c209c93` finds zero hits. The control grep (`aria-label`, same tree) does hit.
- **Assumption 2 does not hold.** Close is not first in DOM order: `MobileDialogContent` renders its Close button after `{children}`. A probe of the loaded flat dialog read the tab order `input, input, Cancel, Create, Close`, with Close last and focus still on Close. Radix's focus scope picks the first tabbable element when the content mounts. At that moment `ModalForm`'s body is still its loading skeleton (the object schema read, the record read on edit, and the `React.lazy` field widgets), and the footer is not drawn yet. Close was the only tabbable element. The master-detail arm landed on one of its own buttons for the same reason.
- **Assumption 3 is respected.** Nothing under `packages/components` changes. The handler rides `MobileDialogContent`'s existing prop spread onto Radix's `Content`.

## Where it lands, and why there

- **The skip link targets the route slot, not the `main` element.** `main` is rendered by `@object-ui/layout`'s `AppShell`, which takes no id or ref for it, and adding one would be a new prop on a published component. The route slot is `ConsoleLayout`'s own element and holds the page of every app route.
- **The focus fix lands in `@object-ui/plugin-form`, not in the host `AppContent`.** The claim allowed this placement for the case where the form owns the focus. The cause is `ModalForm`'s own loading. `AppContent` only hands `ModalForm` a schema, and it cannot see when the body lands without a new schema key. `initialFieldFocus.ts` is not exported from the package entry.
- `ObjectView.tsx` is not touched (objectui#13139 is in flight there).

## Selectors for the browser reading

- **Skip link:** `[data-testid="console-skip-to-content"]` (also `a[href="#console-main-content"]`). It should be the first Tab stop from page load.
- **Main region:** `#console-main-content`, the same element as `[data-testid="console-route"]`. After Enter on the skip link it is `document.activeElement`, and the next Tab reaches the page's first control.
- **Dialog first field:** inside `[role="dialog"]`, the control of the first `[data-field]` row. Once the body has loaded, `document.activeElement.closest('[data-field]')` is that row.

## Tests (head `7084cff`)

New pins:

- **`packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/modalInitialFieldFocus-13130.test.tsx`** (11 tests).
  - Create and edit dialogs land on the first field.
  - While the body loads, the dialog itself holds focus; focus moves in when the body lands.
  - A control the user focused meanwhile keeps focus.
  - A read-only first field is skipped.
  - The master-detail arm lands on its first field.
  - Unit cases for `findFirstEditableField`.
- **`packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ConsoleLayout.skipToContent-13130.test.tsx`** (5 tests, real English pack).
  - The skip link is the first Tab stop (user-event), ahead of an app-bar control and a sidebar entry.
  - Enter focuses the route slot, and the next Tab reaches the page's first control.
  - The click is `preventDefault`ed.
  - The slot is the link's target, with `tabindex="-1"`.
  - The link stays out of sight until focused.

**Reproduction.** On unfixed `c209c93`, the dialog pin read `5 failed | 1 passed`. Focus sat on `MobileDialogContent`'s Close in the create, edit, loading and read-only cases, and on a chrome button in the master-detail arm.

**Ablations.** Each is a single mutation through `ablation-replace.mjs`, with restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The subjects are imported from `src/`, so no `dist/` is in the path. Every one went in its predicted direction.

| Mutation | Result | Red |
|---|---|---|
| C: drop the observer's focus move | `5 failed \| 6 passed` | create, edit, loading, read-only, master-detail |
| D: disable the user-focus guard | `1 failed \| 10 passed` | "does not take focus back" only |
| B1: remove the skip link render | `5 failed (5)` | all |
| B2: drop `preventDefault` + `focus()` | `2 failed \| 3 passed` | activate, no-hash |

**Suites on `7084cff`** (repo-root vitest, `--maxWorkers=2`, through the shared lock):

- `packages/plugin-form/` + `packages/i18n/`, including the locale parity tests: `Test Files 280 passed (280)`, `Tests 3679 passed | 14 skipped`.
- 153 `app-shell` and `apps/console` files: every `packages/app-shell/src/layout` test, every test naming `ConsoleLayout`, `ModalForm` or `console-route`, and the product-neutral ratchet. Result: `Test Files 153 passed (153)`, `Tests 1143 passed`.

## Gates (local, head `7084cff`, exit captured before any pipe)

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0 (15 source files of 3 released packages, 1 changeset).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0 (`0 new citation(s)`).
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:i18n-drift`: exit 0 (1 key added, 0 en values changed).
- `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`: exit 0. The new key is not listed; two sibling `console.*` keys are, which is the control.
- `pnpm --filter` `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0 each, after the closure build `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (28/28). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both new tests.
- eslint on the changed files: exit 0, 0 errors, and no warning on a changed line.
- Not owed: the doc checks (no README or `content/docs` change).
- Repo-wide lint and the full farm are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

Out-of-scope findings, not touched here. The report hands them to the seat.

- **`DrawerForm` has the same initial-focus defect (measured).** A probe on `7084cff` shows focus still on `SheetContent`'s Close after the drawer's body loads. A named producer exists: showcase `task`'s form view `quick` (`type: 'drawer'`). The fix would be the same hook on `DrawerForm`'s `SheetContent`, but that file is outside this claim's file surface.
- **The record dialog's collapsible section header is not keyboard-operable (measured).** The form renderer's `SectionDivider` (`packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`) draws a `div` with `role="button"` and `aria-expanded`, and only an `onClick`: no `tabIndex`, no key handler. Through `ModalForm` with a collapsed field group:
  - the Tab cycle (`Code` input, Cancel, Create, Close) never stops on the header;
  - Enter does nothing;
  - only a click opens the group.

  So a keyboard user cannot reach a collapsed group's fields. A named producer exists: showcase `showcase_semantic_zoo`'s `Money` group (`collapse: 'collapsed'`). The record detail page's section header is already a real disclosure button; the dialog's row is not.
- **Banners above the shell come before the skip link.** When `ImpersonationBanner`, `ReadRateBanner` or `StorageUsageBanner` render, their controls precede it. `ConsoleShell` draws them above every console layout. An ordinary session renders none of them. They are left in place because they are chrome for every console page, including `/home`, which has no route slot to skip to.
- **Other shells have no skip link.** This covers `@object-ui/layout`'s `AppShell` under `AppSchemaRenderer`, and the home layout. Neither is this card's route.
- **The route slot is now focusable by script.** A mouse click on a non-interactive part of the page focuses it (the outline is suppressed with `focus:outline-none`). No Tab stop is added.
- **Phones.** The first field takes focus when the body loads, and Android may raise the on-screen keyboard. Radix does the same for any dialog whose first tabbable element at open is an input.
- **Tailwind ordering (measured).** `focus:fixed` wins over the `position: static` of `focus:not-sr-only`. Compiling the classes with the installed tailwindcss 4.3.3 emits `.focus\:fixed:focus` after `.focus\:not-sr-only:focus`.
- **NOT MEASURED:** the live Tab count from page load to New on Showcase → Contacts after this change, and how the focused skip link looks. The browser reading belongs to the seat; there is no backend here.
